limitations: Small selected public-control reconstructions only; no full site copy, CSS/media, application scripts, authenticated state or actual extension execution.
Original ancestor tags, IDs, classes, fixed accessible labels and hrefs are retained; omitted unrelated context and original geometry can affect live behavior.
Inline onclick presence uses an inert return-false marker; original JavaScript href text is retained but handlers are not copied. Offline fixtures use script-src none; object-src none CSP metadata.
Readonly focus and center hit tests are limited source reach checks, not a full keyboard or assistive-technology audit.
File links are locate-only; no requested download or actual application/submission action was executed.

annotationValidation.method: Offline fixture DOM and ariaSnapshot comparison against independently observed live-source metadata; product source/tests/detector/ranker/evaluator not imported or run.
